metrics.sts_note: The frozen UMBC endpoint timed out from the local host and an independent DigitalOcean egress path; HTTPS was closed and the current UMBC domain returned 404 for the service path. No substitute metric or zero value was used.

postfreeze_re_adjudication.note: The predeclared gate remains 5/12 because panel membership and predictions were frozen; the two corrected rows cannot isolate answer-stage repair.

integrity_corrections.completed_run_answer_binding: The frozen v2 validator required cited claims but did not structurally require the final answer to equal a cited claim. Manual inspection found no unsupported final answer; future protocol version 2 enforces an exact answer-to-claim match.
integrity_corrections.completed_run_evidence_binding: The original prediction freeze bound terminal files only. A post-hoc additive evidence freeze now binds all current per-row requests, raw responses, metadata, parsed responses, and terminals; future freezes create this sidecar before labels.
